Markdown Table Generator

Paste comma- or tab-separated rows and get a clean Markdown table with your alignment choice.


    

  

  





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Paste rows (one per line, comma or tab separated).
  2. Toggle header row and pick alignment.
  3. Press Generate and copy the Markdown.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Comma or tab separated?
If your text contains tabs they are used; otherwise commas separate the cells.
Is the first row the header?
The first row becomes the header by default; toggle it off for data-only rows.
Which alignments are supported?
Left, center or right — applied to every column.
